name: Paid Content
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Vantage Point's first NBN cards — Nihilo Agent, Grubber, Paywall, Scapegoat — on Hyper Velocity's frame, under Making News. Eternal-legal only. Vantage Point Stage 3a: Hype Machine for AMAZE Amusements, Magistrate Revontulet for Nihilo Agent. Vantage Point Stage 4a: two Lethe for two Tithe. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 1: two Capacitor and two Seraph for three Ping and the Whitespace, which the deck's tags feed, and two The Powers That Be for two Hedge Fund. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4a: two Kingmaking for two Orbital Superiority, for the Superconducting Hub to follow into the score area. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4c: two Stoke the Embers for the last Orbital Superiority and the Offworld Office, for The Powers That Be to install out of Archives; The Holo Man for the Hansei Review and Janaína “JK” Dumont Kindelán for the Hedge Fund. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5a: two Piranhas for a Funhouse and a Paywall, rezzed off the deck's tags, and two Sudden Commandment for two Predictive Planogram. The Automata Initiative Stage 1: two Balanced Coverage for two Public Trail, and two Behold! for the Spin Doctor and the Predictive Planogram. The Automata Initiative Stage 2: two Your Digital Life for two Scapegoat, two B-1001 for Public Trail and Tithe. The Automata Initiative Stage 3: two Virtual Service Agent for two Paywall, ice for ice. The Automata Initiative Stage 8d: two Oracle Thinktank for the Tomorrow's Headline and a Neurospike, point for point, for the Corp to take back off the tag it gives. Parhelion Stage 1: two Gaslight, two Nonequivalent Exchange, two Post-Truth Dividend and a third Kingmaking for its Neurospike, two Manegarm Skunkworks, two Funhouse, a Send a Message and its Superconducting Hub, point for point. Parhelion Stage 3a: two Freedom of Information for its two Stoke the Embers, a requirement the tags it gives lower. Parhelion Stage 8: two Klevetnik for two Seraph, and two Unsmiling Tsarevna for two Piranhas, rezzed on a run at their server. Midnight Sun Stage 4: two Drago Ivanov, two Vladisibirsk City Grid and two Chekist Scion for its two Behold, two Gaslight and two Balanced Coverage — advanceable cards to share a root with the grid, and Drago keeps the deck Eternal-only. Uprising Stage 1: two Bellona for two Send a Message, point for point; every Corp deck keeps Send a Message. Uprising Stage 4: two Digital Rights Management for its two Sudden Commandment, an operation for an operation; Spin Cycle and Grand Opening keep Sudden Commandment. Downfall Stage 3: two Increased Drop Rates for two Hype Machine, an ambush that sheds a bad publicity unless the Runner takes a tag. Downfall Stage 4: two Daily Quest for two B-1001, three credits a turn the Runner pays two to stop, and two Focus Group for two Nonequivalent Exchange, advancement counters bought off a revealed grip. Downfall Stage 5: two Loot Box for two Capacitor, a trap that taxes the run 2[credit] and then hands the Runner the cheapest of the top three cards of the stack for the Corp's profit; Capacitor is in another deck. Reprints Stage 2: two Pop-up Window for its two Grubber and two Wraparound for its two Lethe; both are still in Grand Opening. Reprints Stage 3: two License Acquisition for its two Oracle Thinktank, a 1-point agenda for a 1-point agenda; two Sweeps Week for its two Your Digital Life; two Reversed Accounts for its two Chekist Scion; each is still in another deck. Tranche 8 Stage 9b: two Daily Business Show for The Holo Man and Janaína “JK” Dumont Kindelán, a draw that grows every turn; both are still in other decks. Tranche 8 Stage 9c: two Project Beale for its two Freedom of Information, 2 points for 2, and two SanSan City Grid for its two Magistrate Revontulet, an upgrade that lowers what the agendas beside it need; both are still in other decks. Tranche 8 Stage 9g: two Slot Machine for its two Virtual Service Agent, code gate for code gate, which reveals the top 3 cards of the stack as the Runner encounters it; Grand Opening and Pay to Win keep Virtual Service Agent. Tranche 8 Stage 11e: two Ghost Branch for its two Drago Ivanov, an asset for an asset, and a Melange Mining Corp. for one of its two The Powers That Be, neutral for neutral; Pay to Win keeps Drago Ivanov. Tranche 8 Stage 11f: two Breaking News for its two Post-Truth Dividend and two AstroScript Pilot Program for two of its three Kingmaking, point for point, and two Matrix Analyzer for its two Unsmiling Tsarevna, sentry for sentry; Broadcast Hour and Pay to Win keep all three. FFG F1 Stage 3: two Flare for its two Klevetnik, ice for ice, a Trace[6] that Making News's credits pay for, which trashes a piece of hardware, does 2 meat damage that cannot be prevented and ends the run; three decks keep Klevetnik. Red Sand Stage 17: two CPC Generator for two Vladisibirsk City Grid. Red Sand Stage 45: two SYNC BRE for two Slot Machine, sentry for sentry, two traces Making News's credits pay for, the second taking a card from every breach of the run; Zoned Curriculum keeps Slot Machine. Flashpoint Stage 4: Observe and Destroy and Hatchet Job for a second Flare and Pop-up Window. Flashpoint Stage 5: IP Block, Thoth and Data Ward for a second Wraparound, Matrix Analyzer and Loot Box. Flashpoint Stage 6: Hard-Hitting News and Special Report for a Reversed Accounts and a Sweeps Week. Flashpoint Stage 7: Drone Screen for a SanSan City Grid. Flashpoint Stage 8: IPO, Weir and Honeyfarm for a Daily Quest, the Flare and the Melange Mining Corp. Flashpoint Stage 9: Macrophage for the Wraparound. Watchdog and Paper Trail join it for its tags (Flashpoint Stage 10).
